title: Cheddar Omelette with Sautéed Tomato and Courgette
blurb: A fluffy omelette filled with melted cheddar and topped with softened courgette and tomato
steps: Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and add the courgette and tomato.
Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened, then transfer to a plate.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with a fork until combined.
Heat the remaining oil in the same pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Let the eggs cook undisturbed for about 1 minute until the base starts to set, then tilt the pan and use a spatula to draw the cooked egg towards the centre, letting raw egg flow to the edges.
When the omelette is mostly set but still slightly wet on top, scatter the cheese over one half.
Spoon the courgette and tomato over the cheese, then fold the other half of the omelette over the filling and slide onto a plate.
